title: Double Detonation
description: Explosive HIIT with tuck jumps and squat jumps followed by a mountain climbers tabata

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Step toe taps
exercises.instructions: Tap your foot on a step alternating quickly

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching the back, breathe

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Tuck jumps
exercises.instructions: Jump bringing the knees to the chest

exercises.name: Broad jumps
exercises.instructions: Standing long jumps, cushion and repeat

exercises.name: Star jumps
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs into a star

exercises.name: Squat jumps
exercises.instructions: Explosive squat with a maximum jump, cushion the landing

exercises.name: Pop squats
exercises.instructions: Jump feet apart into a squat, jump feet back together

exercises.name: Mountain climbers
exercises.instructions: In a plank, drive knees to chest alternating quickly

exercises.name: Toe touches
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs vertical, touch the feet with your hands

exercises.name: Scissors
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs extended, cross alternating over-under

exercises.name: Triceps stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm behind the head, pull the elbow with the other hand

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Face down, bring the foot toward the opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
